lines.zh: 浆果味的身体，一节一节地爬。
lines.en: A berry-flavored body crawls segment by segment.

lines.zh: 我身上长着小小的源石。
lines.en: Little bits of originium grow on me.
I crawl along the soil, very slowly.
I smell berries.
My body is soft and light.
I slip between grass roots, heading over.

lines.zh: 我身上这点浆果色，是吃出来的。
lines.en: This berry color came from eating them.
I crawl over a stone.
A shallow trail is left behind me.
I tunnel out a path in the earth.
I'm small — a slow crawl will do.

lines.zh: 我朝有光的地方慢慢挪。
lines.en: I inch toward the light.
The shell on me rasps as it moves.
I stop and roll over.
I burrow under a heap of leaves.
I've just eaten, so I move slowly.
I tuck in the soil with only my head out.
I curl my body up.
The originium on me flickers.
I'm digesting what I just ate.
I'm full and quite content.
Ants go past me.
I count the movements in the soil.
I'll sun myself a while.
My shell has grown a bit hard.
Now that I've eaten, I want to sleep.
I bury my head in the soil.
I make no fuss at all.

lines.zh: 我背上的浆果，你摘不走。
lines.en: You can't pick the berries on my back.

lines.zh: 我背上的浆果压得我往下沉。
lines.en: The berries on my back weigh me down.
Are those berries in your hand?
I'm small; don't step on me.
Do I smell of iron?
Put out your hand and I'll crawl on.
We're nearly the same height.

lines.zh: 我身上的糖霜被你看化了。
lines.en: The sugar on my shell melts under your gaze.
Why are you laughing? Am I not handsome?
A few berries hang off my body.
I burrow a little deeper.
The pain rolls me over.
A piece of shell came off.
I twist my body away.
I shake off the clods on my back.
Soil has got in the wound.
I carry the sweetness of berries.
I raise my head and look.
It'll be fine shortly.
I don't get very angry.
Berries — my favorite.
One of these lasts me a day.

lines.zh: 浆果的甜，把铁味盖住了。
lines.en: The berry's sweetness hides the iron smell.
Berry juice has soaked into the soil.
Set it on the soil.

lines.zh: 你的手指上沾着浆果汁。
lines.en: There is berry juice on your fingers.

lines.zh: 我绕着这颗浆果爬了半圈。
lines.en: I crawl half a circle around this berry.
I nibble one corner first.
I get juice all over me.
Another berry, please.
You touched me.

lines.zh: 我的浆果被你碰掉一颗。
lines.en: You knock one of my berries loose.
My shell is pressed into the soil.

lines.zh: 我拱进松土，只露一节尾巴。
lines.en: I burrow into the loose soil, one segment showing.
I don't hurt; I'm just dizzy.
You stepped on my trail.
I burrow past your boot.
A little soil fell off me.
We bumped, not hard.
I go around you and crawl on.
Another tunnels up out of the soil.
We bump heads once.
We both carry originium.

lines.zh: 两颗浆果壳在土里轻轻碰。
lines.en: Two berry shells touch softly in the soil.

lines.zh: 我们的源石在土里一起发亮。
lines.en: Our originium glows together in the soil.

lines.zh: 土里能听到彼此的声音。
lines.en: We can hear each other through the soil.
This ground is enough for both of us.
Afterward we each burrow off.
Neither of us is in a hurry.
I'll remember this patch of soil.

lines.zh: 我拖着一颗烂浆果往回爬。
lines.en: I drag a rotten berry back home.
I drag it as I crawl.

lines.zh: 我把它滚进自己的土道。
lines.en: I roll it into my own tunnel.

lines.zh: 我的头顶被矿晶硌出印。
lines.en: My head bears a dent from the crystal.
I'm too small to move it.

lines.zh: 我把存粮塞进道的尽头。
lines.en: I stuff the food store at the tunnel's end.
I bite out a small opening.
Juice runs all over me.
I'll roll it home for storage.
I'm keeping this.

lines.zh: 有浆果从枝上掉下来了。
lines.en: A berry has dropped from the branch.
Something fell.
I look up and I see it.

lines.zh: 我的腹足贴着土，慢慢挪。
lines.en: My belly feet hug the soil as I creep.
It fell on my trail.
Let me try it first.

lines.zh: 我身上带着浆果的甜味。
lines.en: I carry the sweetness of berries.
It lies there without moving.

lines.zh: 我用触角碰了碰那个东西。
lines.en: I touch the thing with my antennae.
I've fixed this position.

lines.zh: 我把嘴边的硬颚张开了。
lines.en: I open the hard jaws by my mouth.
It's very close now.
I move in segment by segment.
The soil gets pushed aside in layers.
A trace of iron mixes with the sweetness.
This smells like it can be eaten.

lines.zh: 我身上结着甜味的晶粒。
lines.en: Sweet crystals crust my back.
The originium on me lit up.
Its shadow covers me.
I go around the side.
I stop and wait.
It hasn't moved an inch.
I raise my head as straight as I can.
Now it's time.

lines.zh: 我啃下浆果的一小块皮。
lines.en: I gnaw off a small piece of berry skin.

lines.zh: 我用背上的晶蹭了它一下。
lines.en: I rub it with the crystal on my back.
It rolls twice and I crawl after it.
My teeth are small, and they bite.
I curl up and drop on it.
It didn't pay me any attention.
I gnaw at it again.
I back off two steps.
Juice splashes my face.
I eat until I'm content.

lines.zh: 我的壳上还粘着湿泥和果汁。
lines.en: Wet mud and berry juice cling to my shell.
There's mud still on me.
The soil here is loose.
Shook it off. Berry-scented shell.
I head toward the berries.
Light falls from above.
I smell many things.
This is my first look at the world.
I'm slow, but steady.

lines.zh: 我开始挖我的第一条道。
lines.en: I begin digging my first path.
Fire has softened my shell.

lines.zh: 我从上面摔下来，滚了两圈。
lines.en: I fall from above and roll twice.

lines.zh: 水把我泡得发胀，我浮不起来。
lines.en: Water bloats me and I can't rise.
The soil is thrown up and I'm buried.
A thorn sticks in my shell.

lines.zh: 那道光让我身上的源石发烫。
lines.en: That light makes the originium on me burn.
Too weak to crawl.

lines.zh: 雷一响，我钻进最深的地方。
lines.en: At the thunder I dig as deep as I can.
The soil is gone and I keep falling.
